{
  "problem": "Design a minimal REST API specification for task management, delivered entirely as a valid JSON document.",
  "objectives": [
    "Define CRUD endpoints for a task resource using standard HTTP methods",
    "Specify exact JSON request and response payload schemas for each endpoint",
    "Ensure strict adherence to REST conventions for routing, methods, and status codes",
    "Format the complete API specification as a single, valid JSON object"
  ],
  "deliverables": [
    "A single JSON document mapping endpoints to HTTP methods, paths, request bodies, response bodies, and status codes",
    "Explicit JSON schema for the Task resource with fields: id (string), title (string), description (string, optional), status (enum: pending, in_progress, completed), created_at (ISO 8601), updated_at (ISO 8601)",
    "Standardized JSON error response structure with code and message fields"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Output must be strictly valid JSON with no surrounding text or markdown formatting",
    "API must support only Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations",
    "Must use standard HTTP methods (POST, GET, PATCH, DELETE) and standard status codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 404)",
    "No authentication, pagination, filtering, sorting, or advanced routing allowed"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Task resource includes exactly six fields: id, title, description, status, created_at, updated_at",
    "API uses URL versioning at /v1/tasks",
    "Updates use PATCH for partial modifications",
    "JSON output represents a structured endpoint map rather than a full OpenAPI 3.0 specification",
    "Error responses follow a consistent {\"error\": {\"code\": string, \"message\": string}} format"
  ],
  "non_goals": [
    "Authentication, authorization, or user management",
    "Database schema design, server implementation, or deployment configuration",
    "Pagination, filtering, sorting, search, or webhooks",
    "Frontend UI or client SDK generation"
  ],
  "acceptance": [
    "Output parses as valid JSON without syntax errors or markdown wrappers",
    "Contains exactly five endpoints: POST /v1/tasks, GET /v1/tasks, GET /v1/tasks/{id}, PATCH /v1/tasks/{id}, DELETE /v1/tasks/{id}",
    "Each endpoint explicitly defines method, path, request payload schema, success response schema, and applicable HTTP status codes",
    "All field types, required flags, and enum values are explicitly declared in the JSON structure"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Including OpenAPI boilerplate or metadata that violates the minimal scope constraint",
    "Omitting required fields or using ambiguous data types in payload definitions",
    "Using non-standard HTTP methods or custom status codes that break REST conventions",
    "Output containing markdown code fences or explanatory text that invalidates the strict JSON-only requirement"
  ]
}
